verdict.rationale: The evidence shows CloudConvert has its own operations that act on many files at once: merging multiple files into one PDF and building multi-file archives. Jobs also chain several tasks (import, convert, export) into one request. No evidence shows true bulk processing, meaning one operation applied to many independent items in a single call. missing for 10: documented batch or bulk conversion of many files per job, any limits on bulk item counts, and hands-on or independent corroboration of bulk workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Combine multiple files of any format (PDFs, images, documents) in one single PDF
Create a task to create a ZIP, RAR, 7Z, TAR, TAR.GZ or TAR.BZ2 archive.
the first task of a job could import a file from an S3 bucket. The second task could convert this file... the final task of the job could export the file back to an S3 bucket.
